Deliver a complete PR and communications plan for the campaign:
1) Press and editorial angle
   - The news hook: what is genuinely newsworthy about this launch?
   - Headline for the press release
   - Three story angles for different media verticals (trade press / business press / consumer press)
2) Press release draft
   - Headline and subheadline
   - Lead paragraph (who, what, when, where, why — in 40 words)
   - Body (2-3 paragraphs: context, product detail, customer/market validation)
   - Quote from executive (write the quote, not a placeholder)
   - Boilerplate
   - Contact details placeholder

   - 5 target journalists or editors with beat description and pitch angle tailored to each
   - Embargo strategy recommendation (yes/no and rationale)
4) Influencer and analyst brief
   - Key industry analysts to brief pre-launch (category and rationale)
   - Influencer tier and vertical for earned media
   - Briefing document outline (context, embargo terms, assets available)
